name: One with the Sea
source:
A fantasy visual novel about a curious little river dweller who sets out to capture a mysterious golden fish.

[Edited from [url=https://fartmastarr87.itch.io/one-with-the-sea]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部奇幻视觉小说，讲述了一位充满好奇心的河畔小居民踏上旅途、追捕一条神秘金鱼的故事。

[摘自[url=https://fartmastarr87.itch.io/one-with-the-sea]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
